pr_title: Fix "show max judgement" setting not applying initially on judgement counter display
pr_body:
Closes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/22282

Both `JudgementCounterDisplay` (via the `ShowMaxJudgement` callback) and the `JudgementCounter.Pop{In,Out}` methods were operating on the alpha of the `JudgementCounter`. This meant that if the counter display was created with max judgement initially hidden, it would be hidden by the `ShowMaxJudgement` callback first, but then _unhidden_ by `PopIn()`.

Fixed by only operating on the `State` of the counter, which resolves the conflict.

@mk56-spn advise you take a look at this. It's a pretty common footgun when applying transforms to `this` in a drawable. I wanted to get rid of that, but that breaks tests and it's a real pain to fix that so I decided I didn't care enough, I just want this to not go out broken in a release.
pr_comments:
iirc the starting hidden thing was a last minute change which is why i think this wasn't picked up in the PR. but yeah good learning experience will keep in mind.

 not quite sure i understand the change in the test scene to generate the counter on each test, mind clarifying that? is it just to ensure initial status is  the same across all tests?

To reproduce the test failure, I need to control the order of execution, i.e. I need the counter to be instantiated with `ShowMaxJudgement` already `false`. Without that, I may not get reproduction if I just set that in an normal step later.

issue_context.title: On `JudgementCounterDisplay` skin component, "Show max judgement" setting is not saved across (re)plays even though toggle state is saved
issue_context.body:
### Type

Cosmetic

### Bug description

On the following (re)play after "Show max judgement" is turned off, the setting remains off, yet the max judgement is still shown.

#### Steps to reproduce
1. Add a new `JudgementCounterDisplay` component.
2. Disable "Show max judgement" on the newly added component. The max judgement should not be visible.
3. Start a new (re)play.
4. The max judgement is visible again, despite the setting still disabled.

### Screenshots or videos


https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/37262651/213239891-5306c2a9-9190-462a-a5b7-011cbc5e172a.mp4



### Version

master build (commit 0f3a586, persists through c724938)

review_comments: This is sorta dodgy because `content` changes between test cases. I even [kinda raged against something like this recently](https://github.com/ppy/osu/pull/22141#discussion_r1067407532). My justification here is that as stated [later in that same convo](https://github.com/ppy/osu/pull/22141#discussion_r1067676797) it's tests so it doesn't matter, and without this it would be *much* more difficult to recreate the scene clean for every test case.
